body:
Nitpicks

Small tweaks for various, insignificant mod issues

This resource pack is a grab-bag of tiny fixes for a few mods, things you barely notice until it isn't there. Mostly small text tweaks and subtle visual nudges to make things read and look a touch clearer in-game. --- ### **Supported Mods** - [Arda's Sculks](https://modrinth.com/mod/ardas-sculks) - [Compact Machines](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/compact-machines) ### **Changes** - *Arda's Sculks* - Fix 'Ancient Magma' being named 'Deep Granulite Diamond Ore' - Add missing apostrophe to Mobs creative tab name - Fix 'Ores' creative tab name using 'Arda's Minecraft' instead of 'Arda's Sculks' - *Compact Machines* - Change name of 'Personal Shrinking Device' to 'Player Compression Device' for clarity with Shrink mod. ### **Screenshots** Changes are showcased in the [Gallery](https://modrinth.com/project/nitpicks/gallery) ### **License/Source** This pack is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. ---
